Subject: Quick intro + demo — Redwood Inference (following your self-serve signup)

Hi Sandra,

I noticed your team at LloydTech completed the self-serve signup earlier today — welcome! I’m Priyom on the SDR team at Redwood. Sergio (AE) is looped in.

Would you be available for a 45-minute intro demo next week to walk through:
- How Redwood serves production inference (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- Deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private/VPC)
- A short Q&A for your security or infra team

Proposed windows (all in UTC):
- Mon 24 Nov, 14:00–14:45 UTC
- Tue 25 Nov, 09:00–09:45 UTC
- Wed 26 Nov, 16:00–16:45 UTC

If those don’t work, send a couple of times that do and we’ll align engineers. Also, is there someone from IT/security who should join?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Please include Kevin and our procurement alias for any pricing/terms discussion. Also, we’ll need a copy of any SOC 2 / security documentation ahead of the call — can that be shared?

Kevin — thanks for joining the thread. Quick context: this will be a 45-minute run-through focused on how Redwood would sit in front of your LLM-driven features. Ava (SE) will demo our hosted flow plus options for a private VPC deployment and dedicated pools for predictable latency.

If 25 Nov 09:00 UTC suits, we’ll plan to:
- 5 min intros
- 20 min demo (Ava)
- 15 min security/infra Q&A (Kevin)
- 5 min next steps / procurement handshake (procurement alias CC’d)

I’m attaching a short pre-demo checklist and the SOC2 link we can share publicly; for anything deeper we can send an NDA-backed pack.

Would you prefer 09:00 UTC or should we shift to 08:00 UTC to fit Kevin’s calendar?

Quick note on agenda and what I’ll demo:
- Live inference run to show p50/p95 latency with continuous batching
- KV cache and how we preserve context across sessions
- Latency/cost tradeoffs with quantized weights and batching profiles

If LloydTech is evaluating private deployment, I’ll also show the VPC networking diagram and the steps we take to integrate with customer KMS. If you have any specific infra items (IP allowlist, egress rules, audit-log retention), send those ahead and I’ll cover them.
